_readme: Batch 2: 30 crazier skits 19 Dec 2026 - 17 Jan 2027, DrSigma 2.0 edit style. Facts verified 18 Nov 2026 (see fact.verified). Formats from vidIQ outliers 18 Nov: AI brainrot escalation, boss-fight/game UI, POV, bullet time, inner-brain control room.
style: Stylized 3D clay animation, Pixar-like lighting, vertical 9:16, bouncy cartoon physics, exaggerated comedic timing. Characters: NPC = a grey blocky cube-headed clay character with blank dot eyes, a tiny flat mouth and a floating white exclamation mark above his head; SIGMA = a calm, confident clay character in a navy hoodie (hood up) and black sunglasses. Match the reference images exactly. No on-screen text, no words, no logos, no music.

skits.title: EMREE final boss
skits.prompt: Video-game boss battle in a glowing clay arena. A giant angry clay monster made of stacked exam papers towers over the arena and roars. Left side: NPC charges with a yellow highlighter like a sword, pokes the monster once, a tiny spark, and the monster flicks him across the arena with one finger. Then SIGMA walks in calmly, pulls out a fan of glowing question cards and throws them like ninja stars in slow motion, each hit makes the monster shrink, until it bursts into confetti. Epic camera angles, fast action.
skits.caption:
Highlighters do 1 damage. Questions do critical hits.

What's your weapon of choice? Wrong answers only.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #bossfight #studytok

skits.title: The streak flame
skits.prompt: Single scene, cozy desk at night. A small cute clay flame floats above NPC's head. NPC yawns and closes his book, and the flame shrinks, flickers and blows out with a little puff of smoke; NPC panics and chases the smoke around the room with a lighter that won't spark. In the background SIGMA answers a few questions on a plain tablet and the little flame above his head grows into a big roaring bonfire that lights up the room.
skits.caption:
The streak doesn't care how tired you are. Ten questions and it lives.

DrSigma 2.0 counts your streak, your XP and your rank. Free account, 7 days of everything, no card: drsigma.net

What's your current streak? Be honest.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #studystreak #DrSigma

skits.title: Shockable rhythm
skits.prompt: Split screen, cartoon resus room. A clay patient lies on a bed, a small cute clay heart character floats above his chest shaking and wobbling chaotically. Left: NPC calmly searches the patient's arm with a magnifying glass for a vein while the wobbly heart gets dizzier. Right: SIGMA rolls in a big friendly boxy machine and presses one big glowing button, a cartoon lightning bolt zaps into the floating heart, it freezes, then starts beating in a steady happy rhythm, and SIGMA immediately starts pressing on the chest in rhythm. Family-friendly, no blood.
beats: NPC: hunts for a vein first.
SIGMA: shock now. CPR straight after.
skits.caption:
VF or pulseless VT: shock as soon as possible, then straight back to CPR for 2 minutes. First adrenaline goes in after the 3rd shock.

Save this for your EMREE week.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #ALS #cardiacarrest #emergencymedicine

fact.claim: VF/pVT: shock, immediately resume CPR 2 min; 1st adrenaline after 3 shocks
fact.check: Resuscitation Council UK Adult ALS algorithm 2025
fact.verified: RCUK Adult ALS algorithm 2025: 'Immediately resume CPR for 2 min'; 'Give 1st adrenaline after 3 shocks'. Checked 18 Nov 2026.

skits.title: Anime power-up
skits.prompt: Single scene, a dramatic anime-style power-up. SIGMA stands in a study room, glowing cyan energy swirls around him, his hoodie flaps in a wind from nowhere, the floor cracks, books float up around him in a circle and the camera spins around him as the glow explodes into a beam of light. Then NPC beside him tries the exact same pose, squeezes hard, and only a tiny puff of grey smoke comes out and he sneezes. Speed lines, epic lighting, then comedic deflation.
skits.caption:
There's no transformation scene. Just questions, every day, until it shows.

Tag the friend who's still charging up.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #anime #studymotivation

skits.title: The door closes today
skits.prompt: Single scene, a huge cartoon exam-centre door with a giant ticking clock above it. NPC is asleep in a hammock right in front of the door, snoring, while the clock hands spin faster and faster. The giant door slowly swings shut with a heavy echoing slam and a big padlock snaps onto it. NPC wakes up and bangs on the door. Through a small round window in the door, SIGMA waves calmly from inside.
skits.caption:
Sitting the EMREE on 27 December? Enrolment closes today, 23 December, on the NIHS calendar. Check the portal now, not tonight.

Not ready for the 27th? Use the free calculator on drsigma.net to see which sitting your hours can reach.

Send this to the friend who always says tomorrow.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #EMREE2026 #deadline

fact.verified: nihs.uaeu.ac.ae EMREE calendar: enrolment 4 Dec-23 Dec 2026, exam 27 Dec 2026. Checked 18 Nov 2026.

skits.title: 300 tabs
skits.prompt: Single scene. The top of NPC's blocky head flips open like a laptop lid and hundreds of glowing browser-window cards fly out like a swarm of bats, spinning around the room, some on fire, overheating his head until steam pours out. SIGMA sits next to him, the top of his head opens too, and only one single calm glowing card floats out, he reads it and closes his head with a click.
skits.caption:
Your brain has the same tab limit as your laptop.

How many tabs are open right now? Screenshot not required.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #studytips #focus

skits.title: Choking: back blows
skits.prompt: Split screen, a cartoon restaurant. A clay diner clutches his throat, can't cough, a big green grape stuck as a cartoon bubble in his throat. Left: NPC calmly hands him a tall glass of water and pats his head. Right: SIGMA stands behind the diner, leans him forward and gives firm pats between the shoulder blades, then a hug-style squeeze from behind, the grape pops out and flies across the room into a bowl, the diner breathes and gives a thumbs up. Family-friendly.
beats: NPC: offers a glass of water.
SIGMA: 5 back blows, then 5 abdominal thrusts.
skits.caption:
Adult choking with an ineffective cough, still conscious: 5 back blows, then 5 abdominal thrusts, and repeat. Unconscious: start CPR.

Save it. You'll use this outside the exam too.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #firstaid #choking #emergencymedicine

fact.claim: Adult choking, ineffective cough, conscious: 5 back blows then 5 abdominal thrusts; unconscious: CPR
fact.check: Resuscitation Council UK adult choking algorithm
fact.verified: RCUK Adult Choking Algorithm 2021. Checked 18 Nov 2026.

skits.title: Where's my ID
skits.prompt: Split screen, exam morning. Left: NPC tears his apartment apart in fast motion looking for something, cushions flying, drawers flung out, he finally opens the fridge and finds a small blank plastic card next to the milk and screams. Right: SIGMA calmly picks up a neatly packed bag from beside the front door, a small blank card already clipped to it, sips water and walks out.
skits.caption:
Sitting the EMREE tomorrow? Pack tonight: ID, confirmation, water, the route. Then sleep.

Tag the friend whose keys live in the fridge.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #examday #EMREE2026

skits.title: Your brain at question 87
skits.prompt: Inside a giant clay head: a chaotic cartoon control room full of tiny grey clay workers. Red alarms flash, one worker runs in circles holding a fire extinguisher, another pulls random levers, a third falls asleep on the big red button, papers fly everywhere, a screen in the centre shows only static. Then one calm tiny worker in a navy hoodie and sunglasses walks in, presses one green button, and all the lights turn calm and green.
skits.caption:
Most people know enough. Hour three is where the marks leak.

Good luck to everyone sitting today.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #examday #brain

skits.title: Sepsis: the 1-hour clock
skits.prompt: Split screen, a cartoon emergency room. A clay patient with a glowing red thermometer shivers under a blanket, a big sand hourglass floats above the bed. Left: NPC stacks paper lab forms into a tower and waits, tapping his foot, while the hourglass sand runs out and the patient turns redder. Right: SIGMA flips the hourglass, quickly hangs a drip bag and connects it, the thermometer cools to blue and the patient relaxes. Family-friendly.
beats: NPC: waits for every result first.
SIGMA: IV antibiotics within the hour.
skits.caption:
Suspected sepsis at high risk: broad-spectrum IV antibiotics within 1 hour of calculating the NEWS2 score.

Save this for your EMREE week.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #sepsis #emergencymedicine

fact.claim: High-risk suspected sepsis: IV broad-spectrum antibiotics within 1 hour of NEWS2 calculation

skits.title: Stroke: scan now
skits.prompt: Split screen, cartoon emergency room. A clay patient on a trolley has one droopy side of his face and one arm hanging limp. A big glowing stopwatch floats above. Left: NPC sits beside the trolley staring into a crystal ball, waiting, while the stopwatch spins. Right: SIGMA immediately wheels the trolley fast into a big friendly donut-shaped scanner, the scanner glows, and SIGMA hangs a drip with a confident nod. Family-friendly.
beats: SIGMA: CT now. Lysis window is 4.5 h.
skits.caption:
Suspected ischaemic stroke: immediate non-contrast CT when thrombolysis may be indicated. Alteplase within 4.5 hours of onset, once haemorrhage is excluded.

Save this.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #stroke #emergencymedicine

fact.claim: Immediate non-enhanced CT if thrombolysis indicated; alteplase within 4.5 h of onset once ICH excluded
fact.verified: NICE NG128 recommendations (imaging, alteplase within 4.5 h, ICH excluded). Checked 18 Nov 2026.

skits.title: Dodging distractors
skits.prompt: Single scene, an exam hall in dramatic bullet-time slow motion. Dozens of glowing wrong-answer cards fly through the air like arrows. Every wrong option is built to look right to someone who half-knows the topic. Read why each one is wrong, not just why the answer is right.

skits.title: Pregnancy test first
skits.prompt: Split screen, a friendly cartoon clinic. A young adult clay woman in a long modest dress holds her lower tummy and winces on an examination couch. Left: NPC confidently hands her a giant bottle of antacid and gives a thumbs up. Right: SIGMA calmly hands her a small plain white test strip, a red alert light on the wall starts flashing, and SIGMA picks up a phone with urgency. Family-friendly.
skits.caption:
Any woman of reproductive age with abdominal pain: think pregnancy, and offer a pregnancy test even when symptoms are non-specific. Missing an ectopic is the mistake you don't get back.

Save this.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #ectopic #obgyn #emergencymedicine

fact.claim: Offer pregnancy test to women of reproductive age even with non-specific symptoms

skits.title: Acute severe asthma
skits.prompt: Split screen, cartoon emergency room. A clay patient sits upright gasping, wheezing with little visible whistle swirls coming out. Left: NPC hands the patient a brown paper bag to breathe into and pats his back. Right: SIGMA fits a small clear mask with gentle mist flowing out, the whistle swirls fade, the patient's shoulders drop and he breathes easily and gives a thumbs up. Family-friendly.
beats: Acute severe asthma. Can't finish sentences.
skits.caption:
Acute severe asthma in adults: oxygen to SpO2 94-98%, nebulised salbutamol 5 mg (oxygen-driven), and steroids (prednisolone 40-50 mg or IV hydrocortisone 100 mg).

Save this.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #asthma #emergencymedicine

fact.claim: Acute severe asthma adult: O2 to 94-98%, salbutamol 5 mg O2-driven neb, prednisolone 40-50 mg or IV hydrocortisone 100 mg
fact.verified: Right Decisions NHS Scotland BTS/NICE/SIGN pathway, adults in hospital. Checked 18 Nov 2026.
